specific_objectives: 17.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to describe typical alighting gears of an aircraft and its construction.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Inspection of aircraft tyre and brake assembly; Safety: Wear eye protection and gloves; Supervision: Instructor monitors pressure gauge readings and torque application.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the aircraft landing gear?
Name two common types of aircraft tyres.
Why is regular brake maintenance critical for flight safety?

development.content:
Main landing gear structural components
Tyre construction layers and materials
Brake assembly types and mechanisms
Tyre pressure monitoring systems
Brake pad wear indicators

Tyre inflation procedures and limits
Brake system inspection checklist
Identification of common tyre defects
Brake fluid contamination causes
Wheel bearing lubrication standards

Post-flight tyre and brake checks
Reporting defects to maintenance logs
Tyre rotation and replacement criteria
Brake overheating prevention techniques
Storage requirements for spare tyres

summary_questions: Explain the difference between a bias-ply and a radial tyre construction.
Describe the steps to identify a cracked brake pad during inspection.
How does incorrect tyre pressure affect aircraft braking performance?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the basic design requirements and advantages of a typical pneumatic system to be discussed in Lesson Plan 19.

pft_rows.syllabus: Pneumatic system basic design requirements, brief description, advantages and disadvantages of a typical pneumatic system.
